prompt:
A 58-year-old with limited-stage small cell lung cancer completed chemoradiation and asks about adjuvant durvalumab.

Based on ADRIATIC, what did the trial show about overall and progression-free survival versus placebo, and what were the key safety findings?

rubric_items.text: States that ADRIATIC showed durvalumab significantly improved both overall survival and progression-free survival versus placebo in limited-stage small cell lung cancer after chemoradiation.
Provides the overall survival results: median overall survival 55.9 vs 33.4 months with hazard ratio 0.73 (98.321% CI 0.54-0.98; P=0.01).
Provides the progression-free survival results: median progression-free survival 16.6 vs 9.2 months with hazard ratio 0.76 (97.195% CI 0.59-0.98; P=0.02).

Notes the key safety findings for durvalumab versus placebo: grade 3–4 adverse events 24.4% versus 24.2% and grade 3–4 pneumonitis or radiation pneumonitis 3.1% versus 2.6%, plus either adverse events leading to treatment discontinuation 16.4% versus 10.6% or adverse events leading to death 2.7% versus 1.9%.
